# victorops_rotation (Resource)

Manages a rotation group and its shifts. The group's `slug` is what escalation policy `rotationGroup` entries refer to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "victorops_rotation" "primary" {
  team_id = victorops_team.platform.id
  label   = "Primary"

  shift {
    label      = "Weekdays"
    timezone   = "Australia/Sydney"
    start      = 1704067200000 # epoch milliseconds, not in the future
    duration   = 7             # days per turn
    shift_type = "std"
    usernames  = ["jdane", "asmith"]

    mask {
      monday    = true
      tuesday   = true
      wednesday = true
      thursday  = true
      friday    = true

      time_range {
        start_hour   = 0
        start_minute = 0
        end_hour     = 23
        end_minute   = 59
      }
    }
  }
}

# The slug goes in escalation policy steps
resource "victorops_escalation_policy" "primary" {
  name    = "Primary"
  team_id = victorops_team.platform.id
  step {
    timeout = 30
    entries = [{ type = "rotationGroup", slug = victorops_rotation.primary.slug }]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) The name of the rotation group.
- `team_id` (String) The slug/ID of the team that owns the rotation group.

### Optional

- `shift` (Block List) The shifts in the rotation group, in order. Shifts are matched to existing ones by position. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--shift))

### Read-Only

- `group_id` (Number) The numeric rotation group ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug` (String) The rotation group slug (`rtg-...`), used in escalation policy entries.

<a id="nestedblock--shift"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shift`

Required:

- `duration` (Number) The length of each person's turn in days (90 or less).
- `label` (String) The name of the shift.
- `mask` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) When the shift is on call. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--shift--mask))
- `shift_type` (String) One of `std` (Standard), `fts` (Follow The Sun), `cstm` (Custom), `pho` (Period Hand Off).
- `start` (Number) When the shift began, in epoch milliseconds. Must not be in the future: the API answers 500.
- `timezone` (String) The shift's timezone (e.g. 'Australia/Sydney').

Optional:

- `mask2` (Block List, Max: 1) A second on-call window, for `fts` and `cstm` shifts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--shift--mask2))
- `mask3` (Block List, Max: 1) A third on-call window, for `cstm` shifts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--shift--mask3))
- `usernames` (List of String) The members of the shift, in rotation order. Usernames must be unique within a shift.

Read-Only:

- `shift_id` (Number) The numeric shift ID.

<a id="nestedblock--shift--mask"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shift.mask`

Required:

- `time_range` (Block List, Min: 1) Times of day the mask is on call. Required by the API; use 00:00-23:59 for all day. An end of 00:00 is read back as 23:59, so use 23:59 for end of day. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--shift--mask--time_range))

Optional:

- `sunday`, `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday` (Boolean) Whether the mask applies on that day.

<a id="nestedblock--shift--mask--time_range"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shift.mask.time_range`

Required:

- `end_hour` (Number)
- `end_minute` (Number)
- `start_hour` (Number)
- `start_minute` (Number)

<a id="nestedblock--shift--mask2"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shift.mask2`

Same as `shift.mask`.

<a id="nestedblock--shift--mask3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shift.mask3`

Same as `shift.mask`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import victorops_rotation.primary <team_id>/<group_id>
```
